description: The CNR fisheries energy research team publishes supplementary 2019 logbook observations from 45 commercial fishing vessels. The own description identifies 19 bottom-otter-trawl, eight beam-trawl and 18 midwater-pair-trawl vessels, with active fishing days, fuel use and total or species-specific annual landings. Figshare provides an Excel logbook and a species-reference text file, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The collection was combined with energy audits to relate daily fuel consumption to vessel length and estimate fleet-segment demand. It can calibrate fishing-fleet energy simulations and complement broader transport statistics in data-unctadstat-maritime-transport. A caveat is that the listed sample is not itself a national census, and transferring its length-fuel relationship to another fleet requires validation. Although labelled high-resolution logbooks, the landing page does not establish a uniform subdaily measurement interval. No vessel-level observations were downloaded.
